mapper.select: select max(if(stat_type = '0701', stat_num, 0)) as playStatNum, max(if(stat_type = '0702', stat_num, 0)) as collectStatNum, max(if(stat_type = '0703', stat_num, 0)) as praiseStatNum, max(if(stat_type = '0704', stat_num, 0)) as commentStatNum from track_stat where track_id = #{trackId}
